links.comparator_used: Control chatbot condition (no assigned persona/communication style manipulation), compared with doctor vs breast cancer survivor Black woman personas crossed with direct vs polite style
links.outcome: Trust and intention to use the chatbot for scheduling breast cancer screening
links.effect: Doctor-polite condition was most preferred for both trust and intention to use compared with the control; no numeric estimates reported in the abstract
links.tradeoff: Qualitative feedback: some participants perceived the Black woman persona as stereotyping, patronizing, or targeting; caution needed to avoid perpetuating stereotypes
links.quote: Among the experimental conditions, the doctor-polite condition was the most preferred in terms of both trust and intention to use, compared with the control.

design_hint: chatbot persona and communication style tailoring
